groups.canonical_value: Include United among preferred, non-exclusive carrier options when otherwise suitable and comparable.
groups.merge_rationale: This behavior specifically prefers United as one acceptable carrier without requiring exclusivity; it is not semantically equivalent to a preference for a different airline.

groups.canonical_value: Include and favor Delta among preferred, non-exclusive carrier options when it satisfies trip constraints and is otherwise comparable.
groups.merge_rationale: This behavior specifically prefers Delta in the shortlist and favors it among comparable alternatives; it is not semantically equivalent to a preference for a different airline.
